crossRefs.note: Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of the sons of Zebedee.

people.name: Magadan
people.line: A place on the Sea of Galilee; home of Mary Magdalene

people.name: Mary
people.line: Wife of Cleopas (or 'Alphaeus'), present at Jesus' crucifixion.

people.name: Mary_Magdalene
people.line: Follower of Jesus, first witness of His resurrection.

translations.web: Mary Magdalene was there, and the other Mary, sitting opposite the tomb.
translations.bsb: Mary Magdalene and the other Mary were sitting there opposite the tomb.
translations.kjv: And there was Mary Magdalene, and the other Mary, sitting over against the sepulchre.
translations.asv: And Mary Magdalene was there, and the other Mary, sitting over against the sepulchre.
